mission.title: Platform
mission.text: We build a space for conscious presence in culture and its profound experience. We work with professional expertise and artistic sensitivity. Contextually, qualitatively, long-term. We engage in production and realization of cultural events and artistic projects. We collaborate with public institutions, companies and above all - creators.

approach.title: Method
approach.text: We emphasize dialogue and mutual trust. We approach each project attentively and consciously, caring for its artistic integrity. We are interested in art embedded in relationships – close to people and the place where it is created.

items.title: Event production
items.text: Comprehensive approach - from idea, through conceptualization and production, to the exciting moment of meeting with the audience.

items.title: Curatorship
items.text: Dialogue between work and space, creator and audience, tradition and contemporaneity.

items.title: Collaboration
items.text: Exchange of competencies and sensitivities with a sense of shared responsibility for the experience of encountering art. Dialogue with artists, cultural institutions, producers and public entities.

values.title: Working principles
items: We treat each project individually, paying attention to details and atmosphere that build a deep experience of engaging with art. We respect artistic value, creative work and the integrity of the work.
The path to the result is as important to us as the outcome itself. Conscious action, reflection and dialogue accompany every stage of work.
We think of culture as a continuous process, not as a series of one-off episodes. We build long-term relationships based on understanding and respect.
Open communication and precise rules of cooperation allow us to build trust and a friendly atmosphere.

context.title: Context
context.text: Specific actions for specific artist, space, work, circumstances. Without universal solutions.

process.title: Process
process.text: Projects maturing at their own pace, in collaboration with artists and partners.

about.title: Discover Lux Artis
about.subtitle:
We engage in production of artistic events, organization of projects and residencies, curatorship, and social dialogue around contemporary culture.
We create conditions in which art can truly exist. We pay attention to context, place and form. We put people first: creators and audiences, with their needs, emotions and sensitivity.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text:
We want contemporary culture to become widely accessible. We focus on supporting creative integrity and initiating dialogue between artists and their environment.
We treat art as a relationship, not as a one-way message. We give works a chance to resonate, which is a prelude to reflection, debate, change.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text:
We provide an independent cultural platform enabling realization of original curatorial programs.
We do not replicate formats, we do not worship commerce. We give voice to artists.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text:
We support the development of broadly understood culture, art and education. We engage in social and integration initiatives. We focus on the West Pomeranian region and adjacent areas, but we are not limited to it.

We realize our goals on many levels: we organize artistic events, conduct educational activities, support young creators. We focus on dialogue and cooperation, because culture is a collective work.

items.title: Quality
items.text: Care, professionalism and commitment at every stage. From concept, through production, to presentation.

items.title: Context
items.text: Awareness of place, time and cultural background. Work in dialogue with environment.

items.title: Process
items.text: The path to the goal is as important as the goal itself. Long-term cooperation based on trust.

items.title: Dialogue
items.text: Culture is a space for exchange. Of thoughts, experiences and emotions. Between artist, work and environment.

items.title: Openness
items.text: Breaking down walls, building bridges, crossing boundaries. Tolerance, respect and understanding.

items.title: Flow
items.text: Mindfulness and ability to be here and now. Joy of encountering artistic creation.

approach.title: Approach
approach.text:
We manage cultural projects in a long-term context, in close cooperation with artists, local government units and the local community.
We don't chase scale or publicity. We perform our work meticulously and with commitment, because we are professionals and enthusiasts at the same time.

intro.text:
Lux Artis creates context for artistic events.

We operate in the field of contemporary culture, focusing on music as a medium of encounter and experience. We organize concerts, residencies and curatorial projects that connect artists with audiences in spaces conducive to mindfulness.

We do not build institutions. We build conditions for art to emerge.

activities.title: What we do?
activities.text:
We organize cultural events that go beyond standards. We support creators through artistic residency programs.

We do not discriminate against any genre. We work with contemporary music, jazz, improvisation, cross-genre projects. We allow artists to exist outside the institutional and commercial channel.

We choose spaces conducive to mindfulness. Sometimes they are concert halls, sometimes unconventional, intimate places, without imposed meanings, allowing pure contact with the work.

Through artistic residencies we support the entire creative process. We give artists time and conditions to work, without pressure for quick results. We support individual sensitivity and neurodiversity.

location.title: Where we operate?
location.text:
Lux Artis headquarters is located in Szczecin. We support regional initiatives and engage the local community. We also operate in a supra-local context, with an international perspective.

Szczecin is not only the city we come from and to which we feel natural sentiment. We pay attention to the high potential of cultural infrastructure and the position outside the main media circuit, which allows us to work without pressure and noise.

The proximity of the Baltic Sea and Germany constitutes an inspiring crossroads of cultures. We see in it the potential for communication and exchange of ideas.

We work locally but remain open to the world. The place of activity is not an address for us, but an integral element of creation.

audience.title: Who we do this for?
audience.text:
We direct our activities to artists and audiences interested in an in-depth experience of contemporary culture.

We do not operate with marketing target group categories. We think about people who seek content, meaning and form of expression in culture.

We are for artists who need conditions for honest presentation of work.
For audiences who come for experience, not for empty entertainment.
For attentive eyes, alert ears and sensitive hearts that do not need reception instructions.

philosophy.title: Philosophy of action
philosophy.text:
We begin project realization with careful recognition of circumstances. We prioritize authentic artistic value over spectacular commerce.

We start from context to preserve the integrity of form and content. We believe that only then can art exist authentically. This approach requires time and patience. We do not care about fast, unnatural pace and artificial marketing. We do not organize events for the sake of it. We want art to live and speak - coherent, free, in full potential.

collaboration.title: Collaboration with artists
collaboration.text:
We implement a partnership model of cooperation with creators based on dialogue.

Artists are equal partners for us. We are not organizers of performances, but curators and guardians of the entire creative process. We listen, talk, jointly seek the best solutions. We do not impose ready-made schemes. We approach each project with excitement and without top-down assumptions.

community.title: Building community
community.text:
We place great emphasis on integration activities. We build a friendly, safe space for dialogue between artists, institutions, patrons and audiences.

Culture needs community, but not every gathering of people creates a cultural community. We support participatory culture. We see the difference between engaged participation and superficial consumption.

We do not organize parties - we create a microclimate friendly to artists and art.

future.title: Long-term perspective
future.text:
We propose strategic, long-term building of conditions for the development of contemporary art in an independent and project-based model.

We think about culture in terms of process, not product. Each project is part of a larger whole. We don't chase scale. We choose quality and authenticity.

people.title: Team
people.subtitle:
Our team consists of curators, artists and enthusiasts. We operate in the field of contemporary culture. We realize artistic projects, residencies and cultural events.

We are not agents of bands or intermediaries. We are people full of passion and ready to act. We create a space where the artist and the work can exist.

perspective.title: Different perspectives, shared approach
perspective.text:
The interdisciplinary team of Lux Artis combines curatorial, production and artistic competencies in the realization of cultural projects.

Each of us brings a different perspective, but we are united by a common approach: love for art and respect for its creators. Differences in experience do not divide us, but expand our perception.

place.title: Place of action
place.text:
Personally and professionally, we are connected to Szczecin, which is why we passionately support regional initiatives and work for the local community. We also operate in a broader context - supra-local and international, cooperating with domestic and foreign partners.

Szczecin gives us an inspiring yet calm space to operate. We are close to cultural infrastructure but away from the pressure of the mainstream. This allows us to focus on quality and authenticity, not on scale and tight schedules.

competencies.title: Competencies in practice
competencies.text:
We have comprehensive competencies in event production, curatorship, cultural project management, as well as in communication and working with artists and in education.

We combine artistic sensitivity with organizational reliability. We treat culture as a form of dialogue and a beautiful space for the exchange of emotions and thoughts. Art is not a product but a gift. We do not sell it, but help it to exist.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about Lux Artis Foundation

questions.question: Does Lux Artis implement projects in cooperation with public institutions?
questions.answer: Yes. We cooperate with cultural institutions, local governments and public entities in the implementation of concerts, artistic residencies and curatorial projects.

questions.question: What does Lux Artis cooperation with institutional partners look like?
questions.answer: We cooperate with institutional partners in a project-based and partnership model. We are responsible for the curatorial concept, event production, artist coordination and communication coherence.

questions.question: Can you enter an existing program as a curator or event producer?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer both original formats and co-creation of programs within existing institutional structures.

questions.question: Do you implement projects financed from public funds?
questions.answer: Yes. We have experience working in a grant model and in projects requiring reporting and compliance with formal requirements.

questions.question: What does sponsorship cooperation with Lux Artis look like?
questions.answer: We build long-term partnerships based on shared values. We integrate the partner's presence with the context of the event – without intrusive commercialization.

questions.question: Do you offer projects dedicated to patrons?
questions.answer: Yes. We can design an event, series or artistic residency that meets the strategic goals of the partner.

questions.question: What are the benefits of supporting contemporary culture projects?
questions.answer: It is real support for the development of the artistic environment, building the image of a responsible brand and presence in a quality and opinion-forming context.

questions.question: Do you operate locally or internationally?
questions.answer: We work from Szczecin, implementing projects with local, national and international reach.

questions.question: What does cooperation with Lux Artis look like?
questions.answer: Partnership-based. We start with a conversation about the concept and context. We do not impose ready-made formats – we build the project around the specifics of the artist's work.

questions.question: Do you organize artistic residencies?
questions.answer: Yes. We create conditions for creative work without the pressure of an immediate premiere or commercial result.

questions.question: Do you only work with specific music genres?
questions.answer: No. We implement projects in the field of contemporary music, jazz, improvisation and cross-genre formats. Artistic integrity is key, not genre.

questions.question: Can I submit a project proposal?
questions.answer: Yes. We are open to proposals that fit our curatorial approach and contextual thinking about culture.

questions.question: What events does Lux Artis organize?
questions.answer: Concerts, curatorial projects, artistic residencies, events and other types of events in the field of contemporary culture.

questions.question: How do your events differ from standard concerts?
questions.answer: We build each event from context, place and form. We focus on depth of message, not commercial effect. Some events are free and accessible to everyone.

questions.question: Where do the events take place?
questions.answer: In Szczecin and in spaces that allow for focused, attentive presence – not always in classic concert halls.

questions.question: Who are your projects for?
questions.answer: For people who seek experience in culture, not just entertainment. For audiences ready for engagement and dialogue.

venusRising.title: Venus Rising Festival
venusRising.metaDescription: Poland's first outdoor festival where the stage belongs exclusively to women. May Day 2026 in Dolice. Free entry.
venusRising.idea: Strengthening the presence and role of women in culture, art, and creative sectors.
venusRising.goal: Creating a meeting space for everyone, without barriers, without borders.
venusRising.queensIntro: The constellation of Venus Rising Festival stars reaches full brightness gradually. Stay alert and follow the signals from our orbit.

artists.name: Magda
artists.bio: We are thrilled to announce that a world-class artist is joining the constellation of stars of the first edition of Venus Rising Festival. Magda is an artist who needs no introduction to regular visitors of the world's most important festivals. Her appearances in Poland are a true rarity – every Polish booking of Magda is a celebration for fans of the finest electronic music. Her career gained momentum in 1998, when as a protégée of Richie Hawtin she joined the Minus collective. Although the world came to know her as a key figure in that legendary team, Magda quickly proved that her artistic horizon reaches far beyond. Over the years she has consistently built her own independent path, becoming a synonym of courage and quality, crowned by such prestigious honours as the BBC Radio 1 Essential Mix and a historic set at the 20th anniversary of the Time Warp festival. In her sets Magda connects tracks in unexpected ways, building a narrative that holds tension from the first to the last minute. Magda is an artist whose work goes far beyond the boundaries of classic DJing and production. Her calendar is a map of the most important points on the global club and festival scene.

artists.name: La Fleur
artists.bio: La Fleur is an artist who combines elegance with the raw energy of the dancefloor. The Swedish artist has traveled an extraordinary path - from certified pharmacist, through a long-term residency at the legendary Berlin club Watergate, to a world-renowned producer and founder of the prestigious Power Plant Records label. Her style is a unique fusion of house and techno, often described as 'orbital' - full of space, hypnotic melodies, and impeccable technique. La Fleur has performed on the world's most important stages, collaborated with labels such as Kompakt, Cocoon, and Last Night on Earth, and her work and talent have been recognized with the prestigious P3 Guld award (Sweden's equivalent of the Grammy). Today, La Fleur is a globally recognized brand. She regularly shares her music at major international festivals such as Sónar By Night, Awakenings, Creamfields, and Life Festival. On Friday evening at Venus Rising Festival, La Fleur will take us on a unique journey into the depths of sound - a hypnotic and captivating culmination of the first day of our adventure.

artists.name: Cassy
artists.bio: Cassy is a figure who needs no introduction to visitors of the world's most important dancefloors. For over two decades she has consistently built her position as a DJ, producer and curator of sound, combining club sensibility with uncompromising selection. Her name has long appeared on the line-ups of leading festivals and legendary clubs. In 2020 the artist made a conscious reset. Today she speaks about DJing from a perspective of greater mindfulness and humility towards the dancefloor. She understands the dynamics of the night, the tension of the crowd and the significance of the right moment. Her approach can be summed up in one sentence: less ego, more truth. This is a philosophy that translates into hypnotic, organic sets – built patiently, with attention to dramaturgy and authentic energy. 2023 brought Cassy a series of releases on her Kwench Records label. Reaching for classic tools – including the iconic Roland TR-808 drum machine – Cassy returns to the roots and aesthetics that shaped her during her Berlin years. Minimalist form, raw groove, subtle vocals and the courage to expose her individual production style give her an exceptional character. Cassy does not follow trends or tick off career milestones according to external standards. She chooses authenticity and creative freedom – representing herself honestly and without filters, both behind the decks and in the studio. Her sets are a dialogue with the audience, her productions a testament to the love of club culture. Cassy is one of the most distinctive and respected figures in world electronic music.

artists.name: Lika
artists.bio: Lika is one of the most distinctive representatives of the new wave of European house - an artist who combines stage energy with deep musical sensitivity. Based in Munich, she builds her sets creating a space where emotion and rhythm remain in perfect balance. Her foundation is classical musical education - piano and vocal experience translate into conscious narrative guidance and exceptional harmonic sensitivity. Thanks to this, each of her performances has a coherent dramaturgy and authentic identity, going beyond the standard club format. The dynamic development of her career is confirmed by the growing international community around her online channel, which in a short time has attracted over 110,000 subscribers from around the world. Lika systematically marks her presence on the European club scene from Germany and Austria to Greece, and upcoming performances in Poland and Croatia confirm her growing popularity. Currently, Lika is intensively developing her production work on original material that is a natural extension of her stage aesthetics. At Venus Rising Festival, Lika represents a new generation of artists who boldly redefine the contemporary club music scene.

artists.name: Roma Leopard
artists.bio: Roma Leopard is an artist whose musical profile is defined by sunny, organic groove. In 2024, she joined the Soul Service collective, becoming the youngest person in its lineup. The group has been popularizing funk and soul for over two decades, including through the cult Polish Funk release series, bringing back recordings from Polish phonographic archives. Her sets are a smooth journey through disco, soul, funk, latin, and afrobeat. Roma builds energetic narratives based on the sounds of the 70s and 80s. Roma Leopard will open Venus Rising Festival with a vinyl set.

artists.name: Diana d'Rouze
artists.bio: One of the most recognisable figures on the Polish club scene. Behind the decks since 1997. She has honed her craft all over the world – including in Ibiza, the United Kingdom and the USA. She has performed alongside the greatest legends of the world, such as Carl Cox, Sven Väth and Paul Kalkbrenner. A resident and regular fixture at the most important Polish clubs. The artist is known for her extraordinary sense of selection – her sets are dynamic, emotionally rich stories in which she seamlessly blurs the boundaries between classic Techno, Progressive and Tech House. As she puts it herself: "You don't have to confine yourself to one genre. You can build your style on diversity and constantly surprise people."

regulations.title: Event Regulations: Venus Rising Festival 2026
regulations.subtitle:
Venue: Dolice (GCK / Municipal Stadium / Dworek Wiktoria)
Date: May 1–2, 2026

sections.title: §1. General Provisions
points: The Festival is organized by the Lux Artis Foundation in cooperation with the Mayor of Dolice Commune and the Commune Cultural Center in Dolice.
The event is open and free of charge.
Entering the Festival grounds constitutes acceptance of these Regulations.
Participants are obliged to comply with instructions issued by security services and representatives of the Organizer.

sections.title: §2. Safety and Infrastructure
points: Medical Care: During the hours of 12:00–22:00, a marked first aid point and mobile rescue patrols are available on the Festival grounds.
Sanitary Facilities: The Organizer provides publicly accessible sanitary containers and hand washing points, located in visible places on the festival grounds.
Lighting and Terrain: The main festival arena and access roads are illuminated. Participants are asked to exercise particular caution in areas with increased traffic.

sections.title: §3. Order Rules and Prohibitions
points: Alcohol and Substances: The consumption of alcohol outside designated gastronomic zones is strictly prohibited. Bringing your own alcohol and intoxicants is forbidden.
Drinks and Food: Bringing your own beverages and food items onto the festival grounds is prohibited.
Dangerous Items: Bringing items that may pose a safety threat is prohibited (weapons, sharp tools, pyrotechnic materials, glass containers).
Behavior: Persons behaving aggressively, visibly under the influence of intoxicants, or disturbing public order will be removed from the event premises by security services.

sections.title: §4. Parking and Transport
points: The Organizers provide parking zones for Festival participants in publicly accessible locations.
Parking outside designated zones in a manner that obstructs emergency services and disrupts public traffic will result in intervention by the appropriate services.
Participants are encouraged to use public transport (PKP Dolice is within walking distance of the Festival grounds).

sections.title: §5. Image Protection (GDPR)
points: The Festival is documented in photo and video form.

Entering the event premises is equivalent to expressing voluntary consent to the free recording and publication of the Participant's image in promotional, press, and social media materials of the Organizer and Partners.

sections.title: §6. Liability
points: The Organizer is not liable for Participants' property left unattended or lost on the Festival grounds.

As VRF, we care about our collective safety, which is why we will launch a Lost and Found Point on the festival grounds. Our volunteers will take care of every lost item and help you safely recover your belongings.
Festival participants are obliged to take care of the common area, not to litter, and not to leave items unattended.
Minors may stay on the event premises only under the supervision of adults who take full responsibility for them.
The Organizer reserves the right to make changes to the program for reasons beyond their control (e.g., weather conditions).
